cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 22nd Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 22nd Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

dorms.name: Deluxe 6 Bed Female Dorm Ensuite
dorms.description: Female dormitory style and range in size from 2 beds upwards.  They offer female accommodation.
dorms.labelDescription: 6 Privacy Bed (Female) + Ensuite is a popular choice for women. Those extra things we need like curtains on each bunk for privacy, a towel, hairdryer, straightener - you get it all! Air conditioning keeps this room cool in summer and warm in winter.

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only
paymentProcedure.description:
Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.

privates.name: Superior Double Bed Private Ensuite
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Private Queen + Ensuite & Courtyard is the perfect cheeky Noosa escape. Your own private space set amongst the tropical garden courtyard but enjoy the vibe of the hostel.  Perfect for a minimum 1 night stay close to everything in Noosa.
